summary: Measure EVE and NII sensitivity, test IRRBB scenarios and prepare ALCO decisions. Explore the five-day course and request details.
lede: Bank asset-liability management training helps treasury, risk and finance professionals assess banking-book interest-rate exposure and prepare ALCO decisions. Participants practise repricing-gap analysis, EVE and NII sensitivity, and rate-scenario interpretation, then review deposit assumptions and turn findings into concise ALCO recommendations with limits and follow-up actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare or challenge banking-book interest-rate risk analysis and bring findings to treasury and ALCO decisions.
modules: IRRBB Model Review and ALCO Limits
prerequisites: Working knowledge of banking balance sheets, treasury products or financial risk reporting is recommended. No coding is required; exercises use spreadsheet calculations. The course treats IRRBB measurement and stress testing at an operational application level, while model validation and advanced modelling receive conceptual coverage.
